mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that increases equity risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which signals a robust economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles with persistently high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve's aggressive rate hikes compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 6.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes where unemployment falls below 3.5%, the economy is overheating, leading to higher inflation and potential Fed tightening, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
